text:
zoe: Saw a spike in 413s on /embeddings for mixed-dim batches. Customers sending 60-150 arrays with dims like 128/768/2048 together. Payloads ~5-10MB.

liam: Are they setting any shape header?

zoe: No. Our JS SDK beta can send X-Embed-Shape but not enabled broadly. Runtime currently inspects JSON which costs CPU.

anya: Two quick ideas: (A) cheap preflight endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight that takes dims+counts and returns split_plan + est_latency/cost, or (B) a small hint header X-Embed-Shape: 128:10,768:20. Prefer preflight for caching.

liam: Preflight sounds good. Telemetry needs: preflight_requests, preflight_cache_hit, preflight_latency_ms. Console should show preflight_hit_ratio and per-tenant avg_split_count.

zoe: While building, add short-term header X-Embed-Prefer-Split=true so proxies can opt-in to byte-splitting and avoid parse. Document it as an escape hatch.

infra-bot: deploy: feature flag embed.preflight behind rollout group alpha(5%).

metrics-bot: Alert: embed_413_rate for alpha jumped to 1.8% (baseline 0.2%).

anya: Hold expansion. Need dashboard tiles: preflight_success, preflight_cache_hit_ratio, embed_413_rate. Canary criteria: preflight_success>95% and embed_413_rate within 0.3% of baseline.

liam: I'll add SDK opt-in to call preflight when payload>2MB or mixed dims. Also include fallback if preflight fails.

zoe: I'll PR runtime to add preflight endpoint and the short header support.

anya: Action items: liam SDK change, zoe runtime preflight, infra add metrics & dashboards, wait for canary metrics before widening.
